clock_source_declared: Synthetic fixture UTC only; NO physical clock

configuration.conversion: Triggered bus + shunt, 1052 us each, 16 averages

measurement_boundary: Both voltage channels measure at J2 after both shunts. Load energy excludes both shunt losses; 120 W is the source-envelope ceiling, not guaranteed delivered load power.
runtime_limit_boundary: Logger voltage/power checks apply only at J2. The program cannot enforce upstream source voltage, power or fault limits and does not disconnect the load.
sampling_limit: Steady or slowly varying bench loads; samples do not continuously observe intersample transients
sampling_method: Discrete bus/shunt sample pairs; integrate V*I separately using actual timestamps

station_spec.reference_shunt_value_basis: Vishay WSK2512R0100FEA exact four-terminal candidate, 10 mOhm +/-1%, 1 W, +/-35 ppm/C; component not procured or characterized
station_spec.shunt_value_basis: Adafruit 5832 populated onboard 15 mOhm shunt; 0.25 W rating is a conservative UNVERIFIED planning allowance; schematic vs product tolerance conflicts; inspect actual board before assembly

timestamp_basis: Host UTC after completed triggered conversion and register/config reads
